authorization: Temporary isolated measurement only; production dnsmasq remains running and unchanged.
environment: Xiaomi AX3000T physical router, fresh loopback-only network namespace for each case

observed_scale.source: root read-only tally of /etc/hosts plus /tmp/hosts/* and lease file

lifecycle.host_fixture: One synthetic IPv4 A name per line; final line is a changing marker. The small fixture matches observed name count, not the original address-family/alias topology.

marker_generations.scope: 20 deterministic complete file generations per round; ordinary body stays fixed, marker changes each time to reject stale visibility.

lifecycle.protocol_refinement: The general protocol mentions alternating two complete hosts versions. This concrete pre-run manifest uses 20 deterministic marker generations with identical ordinary records, preserving the complete-file replacement and freshness check.
lifecycle.leases: Private prefilled finite leases with 12-hour expiry, loaded by the test daemon; synthetic MACs and loopback addresses only.

timing_boundaries.startup: Immediately before fork/exec to first correct marker answer; previous iteration shutdown and file preparation are outside latency.
timing_boundaries.hup: Immediately before signalling own child SIGHUP to first correct new marker answer; file preparation/rename is outside latency, daemon file reads are inside.
timing_boundaries.config: Immediately before terminating own old child through wait, new fork/exec and first correct answer from the changed primary config; not SIGHUP config re-read.

cpu_boundaries.per_sample_hup: Parent utime+stime+cutime+cstime difference between immediately before preparation and after new marker visibility. Includes tiny file preparation/controller interval while daemon is alive; not preparation controller CPU.
cpu_boundaries.per_sample_startup_and_config: New daemon parent plus waited-child ticks through first correct answer. Config excludes previous daemon shutdown CPU.
cpu_boundaries.whole_round: RUSAGE_CHILDREN after all owned children reaped; includes initial readiness, gaps, old/new daemon shutdown. Label whole-round rather than signal-only CPU.

lifecycle.resource_boundary: RSS components, FD and thread count are sampled at readiness, not guaranteed instantaneous peaks.
lifecycle.quantization: One-ms DNS observation interval plus scheduling. Sub-resolution latency differences and CPU below tick precision do not establish faster/slower.

ports.namespace: fresh loopback-only, no links to production network

dhcp.mac_mapping: 02:00:00:6a:00:00 through 02:00:00:6a:00:95 map to the 150 addresses; synthetic static DHCP mappings, not real clients.
dhcp.measurement_admission: All 150 clients must have completed DORA before the measurement epoch or the tool fails; no DORA may enter measured renewal counts.
dhcp.dora_metric: Separate .dhcp-dora.jsonl contains each first DISCOVER send through final ACK. 150 latency samples per round; offered 100 operations/s is not maximum throughput.
dhcp.renew_metric: Scheduled and actual send to ACK latencies for the 2000 measured REQUEST/ACK operations; retain all errors, skips and timeouts.
dhcp.cpu_boundary: Use the actual captured resource endpoints. If they span warmup plus measurement, label CPU as 150 DORA + 2350 renew combined and divide by all 2500 successful operations, never only 2000 renew. Separate DORA CPU is not isolated by this run. Only an exact measured-epoch endpoint delta may be labelled pure renewal CPU.
dhcp.setup_cpu_limitation: Warmup contains 150 DORA and then 350 renewals; whole-warmup CPU is not DORA-only CPU.
dhcp.cleanup: Keep private 150 leases for evidence, then terminate only the owned test daemon/process group; no packets or releases are sent into the production network.

safety_scope.controller: Root alone operates the router; the independent guard may stop the owned process group on health or deadline failure.

limitations: Loopback excludes Wi-Fi, Ethernet, switch, and physical client scheduling costs.
Static synthetic DHCP mapping with no-ping excludes address conflict probing and dynamic allocation search.
No production DHCP script or ubus publication costs; these numbers do not measure complete integration overhead.
Initial configuration and fixture file writing are not included in lifecycle latency.
No capacity saturation, long-term retention, or production reload is attempted.
PSS and USS unavailable on this kernel; RSS and RssAnon must not be relabelled private memory.
